learning_outcomes.text: Provide knowledge and skills related to polymer definition and classification, and examine industrial applications of polymer technology.
Comprehend polymerization reactions and polymer characterization methods.
Acquire knowledge of polymer molecular weight concepts and determination methods.
Comprehend polymerization processes and interpret diagrams related to the physical, structural, and mechanical properties of polymers.
Ability to work individually and in groups to solve polymer engineering problems.

syllabus_topics: Structural, mechanical, and electrical properties of polymers
Basic definitions and classification of polymers
Macromolecular order, primary and secondary bonds, intermolecular order
Types of polymer molecular weight and determination methods, polydispersity
Linear step polymerization, kinetics, and molecular weight control
Bulk and solution polymerization processes and industrial applications
Emulsion and suspension polymerization processes and applications
Structural, physical, and mechanical properties of polymers
Polymer composites, nanocomposites and their applications
Properties and applications of semiconducting and conducting polymers
